title: Variance of restricted means
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $\\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. For each assignment of signs to the coordinates outside $J$, average $f$ over all sign assignments on $J$. The variance of these averages, over uniformly chosen assignments outside $J$, equals the sum of the squares of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ indexed by nonempty subsets of coordinates outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
